clinical_radiology_report: Thin-walled pulmonary cysts diffusely distributed throughout both lungs with preservation of lung volumes.
Subpleural basilar reticular opacities with architectural distortion, traction bronchiectasis, and honeycombing.
Large heterogeneous rim-enhancing necrotic intra-axial mass in the right frontal lobe with extensive surrounding vasogenic edema.
Bilateral symmetric ground-glass opacities with superimposed interlobular septal thickening demonstrating crazy-paving pattern.
Bilateral symmetric hyperintensity in the caudate nuclei and anterior putamina on diffusion-weighted imaging (cortical ribboning).
